inputs: H, P, N are actual archived REAL32 readbacks on the inherited PR99 fixed free-face support
scale: s = norm2(Nstored-Hstored) / norm2(Pstored-Hstored), one global scalar over both wind components and all native levels on free faces
ideal_control: Astar = Hstored + s*(Pstored-Hstored) on free faces; Astar = Hstored on fixed/exterior faces
storage: Cast Astar once to REAL32, then use the exact stored readback; never fit s after storage and never project or alter the uniform direction
norm_tolerance: Before writing a candidate, derive the admissible readback norm mismatch from the L2 envelope of half the local REAL32 ULP at Astar, plus a binary64 operand-scaled arithmetic envelope. For H+s(P−H), use gamma4=4u/(1−4u) times (|H|+|s|(|P|+|H|)) componentwise, then an L2 norm; for subtraction, norm, and ratio calculations use operand-scaled binary64 bounds. Report the observed mismatch against this fixed bound
continuous_equality_reference: Reconstruct Pcont = H + bP from the independently verified continuous PR99 projection exactly as PR102 does. Acont = H + s*(Pcont-H) is the reference for the inherited A_k b_k = 0 equality proof; do not claim the actual stored-P ideal has exact zero residual
stored_to_continuous_bound: Bound ||Areadback-Acont||2 by s*||Pstored-Pcont||2 plus the REAL32 half-ULP L2 storage envelope, gamma4 formula-arithmetic envelope, and operand-scaled subtraction/norm/ratio envelope; require the actual stored-to-continuous distance to fit this bound, then report actual stored residual and archived native-consumer outcome separately
inherited_controls: Reuse the receipt-bound PR99 support, native fixed carrier, zero exterior, source identities, and strict additional-change budget Delta. Require the control to satisfy the inherited stored readback budget; no solver, new weights, model, or prior
assessment: Use existing archived native consumer gates and matched archived arm identities; source amplitude matching alone is not admission or validation
